itemized.notes: Itemization is on filer-supplied spreadsheets: p4 (LANDSCAPE, hand-titled 'Contributions') and p6 (PORTRAIT, hand-titled 'Expenditures'); the Schedule form pages 3 and 5 carry only the handwritten words 'See Attached'. p4 read via PIL rotate(90) (counter-clockwise) - the OPPOSITE sign from the Nelson and Reberg attachments in this same chunk, confirming the brief's warning that the sign is per file; geometry converted back to poppler's portrait render. p4's Address column is COUNTY-REDACTED (solid black band) so donor_city/donor_state are blank - redacted, not filer-omitted; p6 has no address column at all. Contribution rows are not strictly in date order (8/19/14 is printed above 8/15/14). Three IN-KIND contributions (Murray Motor $3,000, Snarr Brothers $5,000, Arbor Works $500) have matching same-named expenditure lines on p6 - the standard offsetting in-kind pair; the p6 sheet carries no In-Kind column so in_kind is not asserted on the expenditure side. LABEL vs FORM: the cover's pre-printed subtitle reads '[County Officeholders - Year-End]' but the checked Type-of-Report box is SEPTEMBER 15 (period ending September 10, 2014), which matches the clerk listing label 'Interim Report: September 15'; the subtitle is boilerplate, not the report type. Summary Page arithmetic closes: 375.00 + 30,385.00 = 30,760.00; 30,760.00 - 12,120.58 = 18,639.42.
